protocol.selection: Both Minigrid1a and Minigrid1b; same site, same aggregate meter entity.
protocol.split: First complete midnight-to-midnight day trains; ALL subsequent complete days test. Partial days excluded.
protocol.prediction: Repeat first-day hourly current shares; compare fixed flat 1/24 shares. No tuning.
protocol.target: 24 hourly shares of the reported current column, normalized separately within each evaluation day.
protocol.metrics: MAE and RMSE of shares, multiplied by 100 for percentage-point display. Lower is better.
protocol.scope: Timing shape only; no daily total, kWh, RAMP, household forest or unseen-site prediction is evaluated.

dataset.title: Data for: Comparison of load profiles in a mini-grid: assessment of performance metrics using measured and interview-based data
dataset.attribution: Hartvigsson, Elias; Ahlgren, Erik (2018), Data for: Comparison of load profiles in a mini-grid: assessment of performance metrics using measured and interview-based data, Mendeley Data, V1, doi:10.17632/bbtn9wxhzm.1; CC BY-NC 3.0. Numeric originals unchanged; descriptive statistics derived locally.

limitations: Retrospective recipe; not a preregistered or untouched final model test.
Repeated recordings belong to ONE site; hourly bins are correlated, not independent samples.
Source columns lack headers. The reported average equals the min/max midpoint within rounding; true time-average semantics remain uncertain.
README clock and paper's one-minute interval determine day boundaries. Absolute dates/timezone are unknown.
No concurrent measured voltage or power factor: no conversion to kWh is made.
No automatic implication for Lamwo, cold-start demand, growth, RAMP shapes or survey-model accuracy.
Noncommercial research demonstration; no commercial data-training permission established.
